name: Hatim al-Ta'i
bio: Hatim al-Ta'i was a pre-Islamic horseman and poet of Tayy in Najd. His name became proverbial for hospitality, and his verse often sets the passing of wealth beside the name a person leaves behind. Al-Zirikli records a journey to Syria, his marriage to Mawiyya bint Hujr of Ghassan and his death at Awarid in the mountains of Tayy. He dates the death to 46 years before the Hijra (578 CE).
